subject: Proposal: 3-week 'Safety Buffer' add-on — credit vs engineering-hours
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novahealth.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — short extension ask

Hi Mina,

We ran into higher-than-expected usage during the last integration week and are at risk of hitting the end of our 30-day pilot a week early. We'd like to request a short bridge to avoid losing progress on metrics and the evaluation dashboard while we finalize internal security approvals.

Two things we want to understand from Redwood:
- A short, 3-week "safety buffer" extension — would you do this as credits (token/compute credit) or as a time extension?
- If you can only offer credits, can we exchange a portion for engineering support hours (your team helping with model prompts and integration) rather than raw credits?

We're open to a small fee for surge insurance if that is simpler for procurement. Budget owner is myself (Ellen), but Rajiv on infra needs the engineering-hours path. Can you send a proposal ASAP?

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of ML, NovaHealth
ellen.park@novahealth.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachment: novahealth-request-ask-0805.pdf (one-page summary of usage spike)

From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-week 'Safety Buffer' add-on — credit vs engineering-hours

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and the attach. Appreciate the clarity on the two paths (credits vs eng-hours). Quick summary of what we can propose today:

Option A — Credit Top-up (fastest for procurement)
- 3-week buffer delivered as token credits covering estimated peak: 1.2M token-equivalent (approx).
- One-time charge at a 15% discount to list hosted pricing; true-up if consumption exceeds estimate.
- No change to pilot end date; credits expire 30 days after allocation.

Option B — Credit + Eng Swap (recommended for velocity)
- 70% of the buffer delivered as credits (discounted 10%), 30% reserved as up to 24 engineering hours from our Integrations team for prompt tuning and infra advice.
- Engineering hours scheduled within the 3-week buffer window (2–3 short sprints).
- Engineering hours are non-transferable and include two synchronous workshops + follow-ups.

Option C — Surge Insurance (procurement-friendly fee)
- Flat surge insurance fee of $3,500 for the 3-week window. If you exceed the threshold, usage is covered up to 25% over the original pilot allocation with a capped overage rate.

Operational notes:
- We can draft a one-page amendment to the pilot SOW — I attached a first-pass (mina-safetybuffer-amendment-v1.pdf).
- If procurement needs a POable amount quickly, Option C is fastest. If you want engineering help to get the evaluation signals over the line, Option B is higher impact.

Looping in Marcus and David for pricing approval and to confirm engineering availability.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachment: mina-safetybuffer-amendment-v1.pdf

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-week 'Safety Buffer' add-on — credit vs engineering-hours

Ellen — quick pricing confirmation from my side:
- Option A (credit top-up): list-equivalent price would be $14,200; with 15% pilot discount => $12,070. True-up term: monthly.
- Option B (credit + eng swap): credit portion priced at $9,880 (10% off equivalent), and engineering hours (24h) covered as a fixed concession valued at $6,000. Net ask to NovaHealth: $9,880 + $2,500 administrative fee = $12,380. We treat the 24h as included for this pilot extension.
- Option C (surge insurance): $3,500 (no true-up), quickest procurement route.

A couple of constraints: engineering capacity for the week of 8/10 is limited — if you confirm Option B we can commit to the week of 8/17 for the main hands-on work.

Kimberly — can you confirm the legal amendment language is straightforward? David — can you approve the eng-hours carveout?

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-week 'Safety Buffer' add-on — credit vs engineering-hours

Ellen/Mina — legal is OK with the short amendment language in the attached draft. A few points to note for procurement:
- If you want the eng-hours included, we'll list them as "Professional Services (non-billable) — up to 24 hours"; procurement often accepts this wording.
- Credits expiring after 30 days is standard; if NovaHealth needs credits to carry longer we can do a 60-day expiry but reduce the discount by 3 percentage points.
- The surge insurance product is programmatically simple — we can provide a POable SKU and a single invoice.

Happy to take redlines on the draft.

-Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novahealth.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@novahealth.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-06T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-week 'Safety Buffer' add-on — credit vs engineering-hours

Thanks everyone — this is super helpful. We discussed internally and want to take Option B (credit + eng swap) but with two asks:
1) Can the engineering hours be scheduled 8/17 and 8/19 (two half-day workshops) with follow-up asynchronous support for 10 business days?
2) Given procurement timing, can you split the invoice: 70% now (for credits) and 30% on acceptance of the final evaluation report (net 30)?

If those two conditions are okay we'll sign the attached amendment and issue a PO by tomorrow. Please confirm and I will route the PO.

Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of ML, NovaHealth
